Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the Company's Annual Report for fiscal year 2025, including the Board of Directors' report and Board of Commissioners' supervisory report, and ratified the Consolidated Financial Statements as of December 31, 2025, audited by KAP Liana Ramon Xenia dan Rekan with an unmodified opinion, granting full discharge (volledig acquit et decharge) to both boards, approved by 99.999% of votes.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the use of net profit for fiscal year 2025 attributable to parent entity owners, totaling USD 132.2 million, allocated as 1% (USD 1.32 million) to statutory reserve, 23% (USD 30.5 million) as cash dividend, and 76% (USD 100.4 million) as retained earnings, approved by 99.998% of votes.
Agenda #3: Shareholders delegated authority to the Board of Commissioners to appoint the Public Accountant and/or Public Accounting Firm for auditing fiscal year 2026 financial statements, and authorized the Board of Directors to set the honorarium and appoint a replacement accountant from the same firm if needed, approved by 99.995% of votes.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved total remuneration for the Board of Commissioners, after income tax, not exceeding Rp14,000,000,000 per year from the meeting's closure, with authority delegated to the Board of Commissioners to allocate amounts and to set remuneration for each Director, approved by 99.999% of votes.
Agenda #5: All current Directors and Board of Commissioners members were re-appointed, including Tan Hendra Soetjipto as President Director and Agus Salim Pangestu as President Commissioner, for terms from the meeting's closure to the third subsequent annual general meeting, with authority granted to the Board of Directors to execute and notarize the resolutions, approved by 99.465% of votes.
Agenda #6: The report on realization of IPO funds usage was presented as informational only and did not require approval, noted with 100% of votes in favor.
